calibrated_on: 5-fold patient-stratified CV of the v8_hardneg recipe (pooled out-of-fold predictions across all 73 training patients, calibration target = mean per-patient FP/uL across the 50 val negatives)
calibration_metric: mean per-patient FP/uL (within-patient pooled across slides, then arithmetic mean across patients)
note: This threshold is calibrated to our internal training distribution. On a different cohort with distribution shift, the achieved FP/uL may differ; see scripts/recalibrate.py for re-calibration on your data.
